title: The Stand-In Retires
headline: THE STAND-IN RETIRES
synopsis: The little stand-in artist who drew every comic nobody asked for gets a retirement party. No art now means no comic.
altText: Panel 1: a tiny robot with a crayon proudly shows Kit the fox a wobbly stick-figure drawing labeled KIT?; Kit looks worried. Panel 2: a retirement party under a HAPPY RETIREMENT banner; the robot holds a small suitcase while Kit cheerfully waves. Panel 3: the robot relaxes in a beach chair, doodling just for fun.
layout: three panels left to right, the party panel slightly wider

panels.scene: A tiny boxy robot holding a giant crayon proudly holds up a wobbly stick-figure drawing of a fox; Kit the fox stares at it
A small retirement party with balloons; the tiny robot holds a little suitcase under a banner; Kit waves cheerfully

dialogue.speaker: kit
dialogue.text: No art? Then no comic. That's fine!

panels.scene: The tiny robot lounges in a beach chair under an umbrella, doodling happily in a sketchbook

dialogue.speaker: caption
dialogue.text: Now it only draws for fun.
